content.title: About
content.content: Vault is a sugar‑free, non‑alcoholic energy drink designed to boost focus and endurance. It contains caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and natural flavorings, but no sugar or calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Vault is sweetened with sucralose, a zero‑calorie sweetener that is about 600 times sweeter than sugar.
The formula was developed together with professional athletes to support long training sessions.
Each 250 ml can provides 80 mg of caffeine – roughly the amount in a shot of espresso.
Vault contains no MSG or artificial colorants, making it suitable for clean‑label diets.
The product is tested to be free of common allergens, including gluten and dairy.

items.title: Increased energy and focus
items.content: Caffeine and taurine stimulate the central nervous system, improving alertness and reaction time.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins (B3, B5, B6, B12) help convert food into usable energy.

items.title: Sugar‑free and calorie‑free
items.content: The lack of sugar makes the drink suitable for low‑glycemic diets.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin C and green tea extract help combat free radicals.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Water content contributes to maintaining hydration during intense activity.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: People sensitive to caffeine may experience anxiety, rapid heartbeat, or sleep disturbances.

items.title: Not for children or pregnant women
items.content: Due to caffeine and taurine, the drink is not recommended for children, adolescents, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and cold medicines.

items.title: Artificial sweetener concerns
items.content: Sucralose may cause discomfort in individuals with rare intolerance.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume one 250 ml can 30–60 minutes before exercise or when energy drops. Do not exceed two cans per day to avoid excess caffeine.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate milk shake in a bottle is a ready‑to‑drink beverage containing whole milk, cocoa mass, sugar and flavorings. It is packaged in a sealed PET bottle, convenient for transport and storage. The taste is rich, creamy, with a pronounced chocolate note.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first ready‑to‑drink milk shake appeared in the United States in the 1950s.
Chocolate is the most popular flavor among all milk shake varieties.
PET bottles preserve flavor and aroma for up to 12 months when stored refrigerated.
Stabilizers are often added to prevent separation of the product.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The milk in the shake provides a substantial amount of calcium, essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Rich in vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D enhances calcium absorption and supports the immune system.

items.title: Contains protein
items.content: Milk protein aids muscle recovery and promotes satiety.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Sugar and milk fat deliver quick energy, useful as a post‑exercise snack.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: High sugar levels can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may need to choose a lactose‑free version.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to casein or whey.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The shake is ready to drink straight from the bottle. It can be enjoyed chilled, over ice, or used as a base for desserts and smoothies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 2 °C to 6 °C. After opening, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.

content.title: About
content.content: Tomato juice cocktail is a ready‑to‑drink product based on tomato juice, often seasoned with salt, spices and sometimes added ingredients like celery or Worcestershire sauce. It is designed for quick preparation of tomato‑based cocktails and is used in bars and home kitchens.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tomato juice became popular in the United States in the 1930s as part of the "Bloody Mary" cocktail.
Many brands use natural flavorings, but some rely on concentrated tomato juice.
The drink is rich in lycopene, the antioxidant that gives it a vivid red color.
In some countries the cocktail is sold as a concentrate that must be diluted with water.
Tomato juice is often used as a base for vegetarian and vegan cocktails.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Lycopene is a powerful antioxidant that may support heart health and reduce the risk of certain cancers.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C helps strengthen the immune system and improves iron absorption.

items.title: Low‑calorie beverage
items.content: Tomato juice provides few calories, making it a good option for weight management.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium assists in regulating blood pressure and supports muscle function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The acidity of tomato juice can stimulate gastric juice production, aiding digestion.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some tomato juice cocktails contain added salt, which may be unsuitable for people with hypertension.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can cause heartburn in those with a sensitive stomach.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Certain brands add sugar or sweeteners, increasing the calorie count.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Tomato juice cocktail can be enjoyed chilled, used as a base for cocktails (e.g., Bloody Mary), added to sauces, soups or marinades. For a milder taste, dilute with water at a 1:1 ratio.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
